verdict.rationale: Brex documents an official MCP server (developer.brex.com/docs/mcp) that lets AI assistants manage expenses, look up users, check cards, review transactions, and track bills via natural language, confirmed by both docs and a probe. Missing for 10: independent hands-on community corroboration of the MCP server itself (community evidence found is unrelated to MCP) and details on auth/security model.
